description: This file defines the 'templateParser' class, which provides methods for parsing and substituting template placeholders with data from CRM beans in SuiteCRM. It handles various field types and integrates with SuiteCRM utilities for formatting and translation.

classes.name: templateParser
classes.description: A class providing static methods to parse templates and replace placeholders with actual data from CRM beans, supporting various field types and related entity lookups.

methods.name: parse_template
methods.description: Main method that iterates over bean array, retrieves beans, and applies template parsing including related module fields.

methods.name: parse_template_bean
methods.description: Performs detailed template placeholder replacements for a given bean, handling multiple field types, formatting, and other special cases.
